text:
Alice M: Quick exec check — launching a small metering estimator update + webinar tie-in. Goals: FAQ refresh, tier-name microtest in the calculator, and routing for inbound webinar signups. @Ben G you owning experiment?
Ben G: Yep. I'll run an A/B for two messaging paths in the calc: 'Committed capacity' vs 'Reserved slots'. 2-week run, hold significance at p<.05.
Cara D: I'll push two micro-mocks to the calculator flow in Figma by 11:30. Need final FAQ bullets to wire in the help panel.
Diego S: Routing idea: use the calc "contact intent" + webinar opt-in to tag leads. Basic rule:
```
{
  "if": ["tier == 'enterprise'", "webinar_opt_in == true"],
  "route_to": "ae_queue",
  "tags": ["webinar", "mql"]
}
```
If not enterprise but webinar_opt_in -> sdr_queue.
Emma K: Drafting FAQ blurb now — will do three variants: concise, product-friendly, and technical. Also drafting webinar blurb for landing page.
Frank L: Metrics to track: calc starts, calc completions, full-report requests (email capture), webinar signups, MQL conversions, time-to-first-response. Current baseline: calc completion 4.2% -> target +1.0pp. I'll add a dashboard tile.
Alice M: Webinar proposed date Apr 14 10:00am PT. Talking points: 1) cost benchmarks vs self-host, 2) latency vs cost tradeoffs, 3) migration checklist. @Emma K can you lead the benchmark narrative?
Emma K: Yep — will produce a 2-slide benchmark summary + short post draft: "How teams cut inference $$ while keeping latency".
Ben G: Quick question: do we gate the detailed cost breakdown behind an email? Conversion vs data granularity tradeoff.
Diego S: Proposed: anonymized estimator always visible; full downloadable report requires email which triggers the webinar invite flow and MQL tagging.
Cara D: UX note — add a tiny tooltip: "Why we ask for email? Get a detailed cost report to your inbox." Keeps friction low.
Emma K: FAQ variant for "Do I need to commit GPUs?": "No — the estimator predicts spend; commit options are explained as reserved capacity versus metered usage." Short, non-technical.
Frank L: I'll tag the experiment as `metering_v2_calc` and set events: `calc_start`, `calc_complete`, `report_request`, `webinar_opt_in`, `mql_created`. Ping if you want extra segments.
Alice M: Timeline: today — mocks; tomorrow noon — content bundles; Thu — routing rules in dev; soft launch next Tue. Any blockers?
Ben G: No blockers from Growth. I'll create the feature flag and rollout plan.
Diego S: I'll coordinate with Support to ensure lead tags and AE queues exist.
Emma K: I'll schedule a speaker sync once the draft narrative is ready. :calendar:
Alice M: Quick checklist for visibility:
```
- Figma mocks (Cara)
- FAQ variants (Emma)
- Routing rules + tag mapping (Diego)
- Experiment flag + dashboard (Ben/Frank)
- Webinar narrative + slides (Emma)
- CTA/button copy (Marketing)
```
Thanks everyone :rocket:
